question.text: The equation of a wave travelling on a string is $\mathrm{y}=\sin [20 \pi \mathrm{x}+10 \pi \mathrm{t}]$, where x and t are distance and time in SI units. The minimum distance between two points having the same oscillating speed is :

solution.text:
Minimum distance between 2 points having same speed is $\frac{\lambda}{2}$.
$\lambda=\frac{2 \pi}{\mathrm{k}}=\frac{1}{10} \mathrm{~m}=10 \mathrm{~cm}$
$\text { Distance }=\frac{\lambda}{2}=5 \mathrm{~cm}$
